name: Refresh radio station list
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * 3'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'stations.json'
      - 'scripts/update.py'
      - '.github/workflows/refresh.yml'
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Update covers and cautiously repair dead streams
        env:
          GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: python scripts/update.py --publish --refresh
      - name: Commit regenerated list
        run: |
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add radio.m3u stations.json logos/
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m 'Auto-refresh station list and artwork'
            git push
          fi
